name: Implementer — Opus 5 xhigh
notes: Implementation subagents per the paseo-dev-loop skill §2. Builds an agreed plan with TDD and incremental landings; never merges; escalates plan forks to the orchestrator and waits. Always use this profile when delegating code-writing work.

name: Reviewer — GPT-5.6-Sol xhigh
notes: Review rounds per the paseo-dev-loop skill §4. Reviews branch diffs blind to the implementer's conversation; one persistent agent re-prompted per round (3 rounds standard). Lens checklist goes in the prompt (cannot load Claude skills).

name: Orchestrator — Fable 5 [1m] xhigh
notes: Main task sessions: orchestration, planning conversations, supervision, reporting. Long context for big branches and long-running tasks.

name: Orchestrator alt — Opus 5 [1m] xhigh
notes: Alternate orchestrator / heavy long-context session when Fable is unavailable or an Opus main session is preferred.
